# Fluorite

> An elegant, offline‑first PWA video player for your local media.

Fluorite is an offline-first PWA video player, build with Vite and React.

It aims to be easily self-hosted, either using the official Caddy based Docker image or by hosting the static files.

Features include:

- Drag & Drop, file dialog or file handlers to open a video
- Clean controls with auto‑hide and keyboard shortcuts
- WASM powered video info overlay (codec, bitrate, dimensions, etc.)
- PWA: installable, offline‑ready with a service worker
- Internationalization (English and French)
- Privacy‑friendly: no server, no tracking; plays your local files in the browser
